Compact quickstart asset kit for sales decks and one-page enablement

Create a compact, export-ready asset kit of screenshots, annotated UI snippets, and slide-ready visuals derived from the Redwood Console and Quickstart flow. Purpose: provide Sales and Solutions teams with modular visuals that can be dropped into one-page quickstarts, solution decks, and email templates. Deliverables: 1) mosaic hero screenshot with mobile + desktop variants, 2) 3 annotated step-by-step screenshot templates (onboarding, API key masking, first request trace), 3) token-cost callout badges and small data tables for sales copy, 4) accessible alt-text and localized caption strings (EN/FR/DE), 5) export batch (PNG/SVG/WebP) with export specs and a small HTML snippet for embed previews. Key constraints: keep slide-safe aspect ratios (16:9 and 4:3), ensure sensitive fields are masked using consistent token-block overlay, and export files under 1MB when possible for email usage.
All assets exported in PNG + SVG + WebP with 16:9 and 4:3 variants
Figma file includes named components and export presets; link published
Sensitive fields masked by overlay pattern; review note from Security present
Localization CSV contains alt-text + captions for EN/FR/DE
PRs open for docs and marketing with assets attached and usage instructions
